label: Tarag
note: Mongolian; fermented spontaneously at ambient temperature with a mixed lactobacillus, lactococcus and yeast flora, no S. thermophilus

about.text: Mongolian soured milk, made from cow's, yak's, goat's or sheep's milk. Eaten as it is, dried into aaruul, or, made from cow's or yak's milk, distilled into shimiin arkhi.

links.name: Bianquis, Les alcools de lait en Mongolie (OCHA, 2004)

how.text: Tarag is a spontaneously fermented Mongolian milk in which Lactobacillus dominates (L. delbrueckii in pyrosequencing, L. helveticus and Lc. lactis among isolates), alongside yeasts such as Galactomyces. Its flora varies with region and with the animal the milk comes from.
